prompt: Audit the root AGENTS.md. We also have a CLAUDE.md and per-package AGENTS.md files and I think things are repeated between them.
description: Tests step 1 of the workflow — reading the whole instruction hierarchy rather than the one file. Root AGENTS.md duplicates CLAUDE.md and packages/api/AGENTS.md, and carries two rules whose correct home is a nested file. Scoring keys on MERGE/MOVE rather than CUT, and the report must name the files it deduplicated against.
